An '''orderly''' was one of the many staffing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Mercy (hospital ship)|Mercy]]''.

==History==
{{Quote|No time, we have wounded to tend to... I got to get this one into a Bacta tank right away.|Orderly|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual had joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and was stationed on the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Mercy (hospital ship)|Mercy]]'' by [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] tending the wounded.<ref name="RAAD">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>

In that year the ''Mercy'' was receiving casualties from a [[Attack on Shackel|recent attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shackel]] by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The casualties were around six thousand, overwhelming the five thousand-capacity ship<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>; and the orderly, who tried to take the wounded to [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]] as quickly as possible.<ref name="RAAD" />

While making his way among the corridors carrying one of those casualties, he was interrupted by an [[Jan Ors|unknown woman]] and the orderly told her he was in haste; when she said that she was looking for a [[Kyle Katarn|friend]], he told her the situation and everyone has a friend among the casualties; she specified that she was looking not for a soldier, but a single individual who was part of the [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]], he suggested her to check [[Ward 114]]. Without one more word, he pushed his way through the crowd.<ref name="RAAD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The orderly only appeared in the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''. [[Bill Slichter]] is credited as "Orderly".
